note: The whole-bundle config_sha256 of every configuration this revision applies, rendered on a host with the shared vision GPU present -- the host Rosalina states. config_sha256 is the digest the controller compares against the live container, so a change here is a change to what is running: not a refusal, a recreate. The paired configurations' bundles contain the Everyday resident's own launch (compose.services.everyday: its argv, its environment, its CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES with the vision card appended), so these five pins are what notice that a commit to the shared-vision placement moved the night-side model's projector or MTP draft along with it. Free-form profile keys -- warnings, retention, notes -- are not in the bundle, which is what makes a comment on a live configuration free; this fixture is the proof rather than a reading of config.py.
